# Everything here is meant to be found, including by the crawlers that feed
# assistants: someone who asks one "what is Vilan" should get a real answer.
# Nothing is disallowed on purpose. The 404 forwarder and mdBook's print and
# toc pages carry their own noindex, so they need no rule here.
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The root's sitemap is kept by hand (two pages); the book's is generated by
# .github/workflows/docs.yml from whatever mdBook actually built.
Sitemap: https://vilan-lang.org/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://vilan-lang.org/docs/sitemap.xml
